scope: Independent design review before inspecting Assignment 10 screening outcomes
objective: Compare the incremental response to specified reporting changes at a fixed prior-reference warning budget, and determine whether a small rule set remains preferable across the declared settings.
scientific_status: A frontier is an established diagnostic. Originality would require a consequential reproducible finding about rule complementarity, robustness or loss of performance in the supported exceptional-return range.

primary_metrics.name: bias_ratio
primary_metrics.definition: B = count(0 <= R <= sampleSD) / [1 + count(-sampleSD <= R < 0)]
primary_metrics.purpose: Excess of small gains relative to small losses; the zero convention must match A9.

primary_metrics.name: normal_loss_deficit
primary_metrics.purpose: Few losses relative to a fitted Gaussian count; it is a score rather than a valid distribution-free p-value.

primary_metrics.name: positive_serial_dependence
primary_metrics.purpose: Positive dependence associated with causal reporting filters, while recognising persistent economic returns also have this feature.

primary_metrics.name: local_zero_score
primary_metrics.recommended_definition: Freeze b=0.25*sampleSD. Count L2 in [-2b,-b), L1 in [-b,0), G1 in (0,b], and G2 in (b,2b]. Use [3*(G1-L1)-(G2-L2)] / sqrt(9*(G1+L1)+(G2+L2)), with score zero when the denominator is zero. Count exact zeros separately.
primary_metrics.rationale: The contrast cancels a locally linear density slope. Under a density jump the weighted inner and outer gain-loss differences retain a jump component. Its calibration remains empirical.
primary_metrics.acceptable_simpler_definition: (G1-L1)/sqrt(G1+L1), zero if both counts vanish, labelled local sign imbalance.
primary_metrics.warning: An exact conditional binomial tail using probability one half is a possible score transformation, but that probability is not generally correct under nonzero mean or skewness. Do not present it as a calibrated p-value or the original Bollen-Pool test.
primary_metrics.bandwidth_sensitivity: One predeclared alternative b=0.5*sampleSD is sufficient for the pilot. Bandwidth must be fixed before its results are inspected.

combinations.primitive_scale: Freeze one right-inclusive historical percentile transformation per primitive score using development data only.
combinations.or: Maximum percentile among the selected primitive rules.
combinations.strict_majority: For q primitive rules require floor(q/2)+1 exceedances, equivalently that order statistic from the descending percentile scores exceeds its common cutoff.
combinations.count_explanation: Fifteen nonempty subsets give fifteen OR rules; strict-majority rules add eleven distinct rules because the four singleton rules duplicate OR.
combinations.calibration: Calibrate every complete combination score separately on the joint unmodified reference. Single-rule nominal thresholds cannot simply be reused for an OR or majority combination.

budgets_and_frontier.grid: Use the declared full 0 to 20 percent reference-budget grid, with 1, 5 and 10 percent as predeclared report points.
budgets_and_frontier.zero_budget: Use an infinite cutoff to represent the operational investigate-none origin.
budgets_and_frontier.discrete_ties: For positive budgets use an observed non-interpolated weighted quantile and strict exceedance. Report nominal and achieved reference warning rates, retaining conservative unused budget when ties prevent equality.
budgets_and_frontier.assessment: Report achieved held-out unmodified warning rates as well as historical calibration budgets. Drift can make the held-out rates differ from their targets.
budgets_and_frontier.envelopes: A pointwise best envelope over evaluated rules is descriptive. Select a rule or subset using calibration data and a declared objective, then assess the selected procedure on evaluation data.
budgets_and_frontier.economic_count: Report additional altered histories alerted per additional reference warning. Actual detections per investor investigation also depend on the unknown prevalence and seriousness of reporting problems.

data_and_selection.calendar_split: Retain A9 development 1980-2004, calibration 2005-2016, and evaluation 2017-2025.
data_and_selection.prior_outcome_visibility: The evaluation data were already inspected in A9. Describe A10 as a pre-specified extension conditional on that knowledge, rather than a virgin confirmatory holdout.
data_and_selection.cohort: Keep the fixed 194 complete-record strategies and account separately for original and forced-value-weighted spread and funded conventions.
data_and_selection.candidate_pools: Use K=1,5,20,50,100,194 with the established exact without-replacement winner weights, calibrated and assessed using the same definition.
data_and_selection.high_performance: Use clearly labelled relative-high-Sharpe strata based on a declared unaltered-record or prior-formation ranking. Report the absolute Sharpe range and support near Fund X separately. A relative top quintile is not automatically Fund X-like or genuinely skilled.
data_and_selection.selection_order: When an altered candidate can change its selection probability, re-rank using its reported excess-return history and retain a separate denominator for a changed candidate that is selected.

reporting_alternatives.accounting: Retain the audited additive P&L ledger for raw spreads and the audited log-NAV ledger for explicitly funded returns. Keep opening and closing gaps, existing warm-up months and future scheduled repayments.
reporting_alternatives.mechanism_test: Specify training mechanisms and held-out mechanisms before comparison. A new delay within an already trained delay family is weaker evidence of mechanism generalisation than a genuinely different reporting change.
reporting_alternatives.smoothing: A symmetric causal filter is a useful sensitivity, but accurate stale valuation and economic persistence can produce similar patterns. Its response is a reporting-pattern result.
reporting_alternatives.outcomes: For each policy report baseline alerts, altered alerts, newly alerted paths and cleared paths, with all-path and changed-path denominators.

uncertainty.resampling: Resample whole monthly cross-sectional vectors in calendar blocks, sharing indices across strategies, representations, weighting variants, rules and reporting mechanisms.
uncertainty.paired_comparisons: Use paired bootstrap differences between rules and between the selected combination and its component rules.
uncertainty.dependence: Neither 194 factor records nor overlapping windows provide independent Bernoulli trials. Conditional bootstrap repetitions also do not create new independently observed strategies.
uncertainty.multiple_comparisons: Separate a predeclared selected rule's assessment from exploratory pairwise rankings. If simultaneous frontier dominance is claimed, uncertainty must cover the full declared budget and mechanism comparison rather than isolated pointwise intervals.
uncertainty.subset_validation: If strategy-family robustness is added, define groups using development information or an existing economic taxonomy before evaluating held-out groups.

minimal_runtime_plan.cache: Compute the four primitive scores once per unmodified or altered panel, then derive all combination order statistics and threshold indicators from the cached scores.
minimal_runtime_plan.pilot: Time a bounded calibration and evaluation pilot, including every representation and mechanism, and extrapolate the full workload.
minimal_runtime_plan.execution_location: If the projected full local run exceeds ten minutes, use the documented CPU26 environment before launching production.
minimal_runtime_plan.avoid: Do not recompute return metrics separately for every budget, candidate-pool size or combination.

falsifiable_outcomes: A small fixed rule set selected in calibration improves held-out altered-path response at comparable reference warning rates across several economic settings.
Different mechanisms require different primitive rules, with little stable universal complementarity.
Selecting exceptional historical records changes the achievable warning-response relation, with the direction and supported performance range reported.
No stable improvement survives weighting, calendar, bandwidth or mechanism checks, leaving a carefully delimited empirical comparison.
remaining_limits: The CZ catalogue consists of retrospectively reconstructed stock strategies and has no independently observed fraud labels.
Source returns omit execution, borrowing and investment-management costs. Gross exceptional backtests cannot establish comparable net live-fund performance.
The ideal type and quantity of rules are conditional on the four available families, budget, calibration regime and specified reporting alternatives.
A broad real-fund fraud-accuracy claim remains unsupported by this design.
independent_verification_plan: Once the engine exists, verify the primitive metrics against scalar formulas, bin endpoint conventions, empty bands, score orientation, percentile ties, OR/majority order statistics, strict weighted budget quantiles and exact selection weights. Reconstruct a small deterministic example with independent loops before checking stored empirical outputs.
